chip.description: V20 core (uPD70208) with an integrated timer/counter unit, DMA control unit, interrupt control unit and serial control unit.
chip.notes: Device table in src/devices/cpu/v5x.cpp (MAME 0.288): "V40 (uPD70208) -- V20 (uPD70108)", with the TCU/DMAU/ICU/SCU peripheral list and datasheet references given in the same header. Filed cpu under taxonomy TB1/TB2 (external program bus).
